Event Details

When & Where

Quick answers for anyone who asks. Volunteers must be 18 or older.

🏈

What

Sell 50/50 raffle tickets at the Seahawks game. One lucky fan wins half of the net proceeds, and the rest is donated to the Seahawks' Spirit of 12 nonprofit partners, including ACRS.

Must be 18+ to volunteer.

🕒

When

Sunday, December 13

Arrival time: 9:00 am

📍

Where

Lumen Field Event Center
330 S Royal Brougham Way, Seattle, WA 98134

Very accessible via public transit.

How the 50/50 Raffle Gives Back

  1. Fans buy tickets from volunteers like you throughout Lumen Field on game day.
  2. The jackpot grows with every ticket sold, and fans watch the total climb.
  3. One lucky fan wins half of the net proceeds.
  4. The rest is donated to the Seahawks' Spirit of 12 nonprofit partners: ACRS and 11 other organizations making a positive impact in our community.
